comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation reports results through four business segments (Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management, Global Banking, and Global Markets) and All Other, managed by the Management Team with the CEO as the Chief Operating Decision Maker for capital allocation.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclose the structure of their residual or non-operational reporting categories. JPMorgan explicitly defines its 'Corporate' segment as consisting of the Treasury and Chief Investment Office (CIO) and 'Other Corporate' activities. Similarly, Bank of America reports results through four main business segments with the 'remaining operations recorded in All Other.' While JPMorgan specifies the CIO's role in its residual segment, BAC delegates remaining operations to a generic 'All Other' bucket, highlighting a difference in how they isolate treasury/CIO activities versus general unallocated corporate functions.

sentences.text: Corporate consists of Treasury and Chief Investment Office ("CIO") and Other Corporate.

The Corporation reports its results of operations through the following four business segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management, Global Banking and Global Markets, with the remaining operations recorded in All Other.

comparisons.peer_summary: The 'All Other' segment includes unallocated corporate costs, net treasury results, discontinued operations, and Legacy Franchises consisting of Asia Consumer and Mexico Consumer/SBMM businesses that Citi intends to exit, as well as restructuring charges related to organizational simplification.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citi disclose the composition of their residual reporting segments that house corporate-level functions. JPMorgan's 'Corporate' segment includes Treasury and the CIO along with 'Other Corporate'. Citi's 'All Other' segment similarly includes 'net treasury results' and 'other corporate expenses'. This indicates a shared industry practice of grouping treasury activities and general corporate overhead into a residual segment separate from specific business lines like Banking or Asset Management, although Citi's definition is broader, also including discontinued operations and legacy franchises.

sentences.text: Corporate consists of Treasury and Chief Investment Office ("CIO") and Other Corporate.

All Other primarily consists of activities not assigned to the reportable operating segments, including certain unallocated costs of global functions, other corporate expenses and net treasury results, offsets to certain line-item reclassifications and eliminations, and unallocated taxes; discontinued operations within Corporate/Other; and Legacy Franchises, which consists of Asia Consumer and Mexico Consumer/SBMM businesses that Citi intends to exit, and its remaining Legacy Holdings Assets.
